g.title: crate Wire vocabulary of the Kivact DevTools: methods, notifications and values.
crate::a11y The accessibility tree, audits, focus and Tab order.
crate::app The protocol version, app, window, client and session values.
crate::call The DevTools methods: the `Call` and `Reply` enums and typed markers.
crate::code JSON-RPC error codes of the DevTools protocol.
crate::common Shared ids, geometry and small enums of the DevTools wire vocabulary.
crate::config The `.kivact/devtools.json` configuration and its defaults.
crate::console The errors the app reported.
crate::discovery Where the DevTools discovery files live; the caller passes the environment.
crate::emulation The environment emulation of a target.
crate::input Injected input, input logs and the IME state.
crate::layout Layout problems found in a window.
crate::motion Running animations and the animation clock.
crate::node Everything known about one element: boxes, styles, semantics and causes.
crate::notify The DevTools notifications: the `Notification` enum and its topics.
crate::overlay Highlight, overlays, pick mode and screenshots.
crate::perf Counters, snapshots, owner trees and trace export.
crate::query Queries of the element tree by role, text or test id.
crate::review The review: items, comments, style changes and the exported document.
crate::review_markdown Markdown of a review document and the locator expression of an item.
crate::rpc JSON-RPC 2.0 envelopes and the reading and writing of one line.
crate::schema The generated protocol schema, embedded for the MCP server and the tests.
crate::scripts The tables a script shows in the DevTools app.
crate::style Style overrides, forced states and theme tokens.
crate::tasks Tasks, resources, actions and timers.
crate::time UTC date-time text from a Unix time without an external crate.
crate::trace Chrome Trace Event Format text of recorded turns and frames (pure).
crate::tree The element tree: node values, tree requests and tree changes.
crate::updates Recorded turns and frames: cause graphs, stages and frame timings.
